# Amics Consulting Group

> AI-native growth marketing agency, founder-operated from New York City. Paid media, AI systems and creative production engineered as one machine. Fully bilingual (English/Spanish), serving businesses across the United States and Spain. Deliberately small: three operators, zero account managers, capped client roster.

## What Amics does

- **Growth Marketing** (/growth): Growth Audits ($1,500 single-channel in 7 business days, $2,500 full-funnel in 10; 100% of the fee is credited toward the first retainer month). Paid media management across Meta, Google, TikTok, CTV/OTT and programmatic. Three retainer levels: Launch (one channel), Scale (multi-channel + retention with Klaviyo email/SMS and CRO), Growth Partner (full-funnel ownership, capped at 3 clients, by application).
- **Websites** (/websites): Websites from $5,500, landing pages from $2,500, Shopify e-commerce builds from $8,500, redesigns from $7,500, care plans from $199/mo.
- **AI Automation** (/ai-automation): 24/7 AI Receptionist from $297/mo (bilingual EN/ES Pro from $497/mo), AI chatbots from $250/mo, workflow automation from $2,000, AI Ops Suite $997/mo.
- **Creative Studio** (/studio): AI-powered production — product photoshoots ($1,200, 20 images, 72-hour turnaround), brand/lifestyle shoots ($2,500), ad creative packs ($1,500; with video $3,000), broadcast-quality :30 CTV commercials ($3,500), brand identity kits ($2,500).

## Key facts

- Founder-operated, three operators: Danny Silverio (CEO & Founder, strategy/media/CTV background), Luis Jiménez (Technology & AI Lead) and Orlando Xavier Colon (Creative Director & Content Lead).
- Based in New York City; works with clients across the US and Spain.
- Every engagement starts with the Growth Audit; audits are delivered in 7–10 business days and credited toward the first month.
- Launch standard: live within 14 days of signature.
- Response time: 1 business day. Contact: danny@amicsconsultinggroup.com
- Site available in English (/) and Spanish (/es).
